description: Get the signed-in user's own Levels.fyi career profile: current title, company, career level, job family, focus area, location, years of experience, skills, certifications and work history, plus the status of their resume (none, pending while it is being parsed, parsed, or failed) and when it was uploaded. Never returns contact details or the resume file. Needs a Levels.fyi sign-in: call it only when the user asks about their own profile or asks you to use it. For a pay check, ask the user instead.
name: get-profile
